subject: Re: Evidence package request — SDLC provenance & rotation logs
messages:
From: Security Assessor <security-assessor@veridian.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: appsec_lead@greenline.com
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: SDLC provenance, CI and secrets rotation

Rafael,

Thanks again for agreeing to provide a focused artifact bundle to support our SIG/SOC2 review for Greenline Financial. To limit scope, could you provide the following for the date range Jan 1 2025 — Apr 30 2025:  

- Code review provenance for three representative release PRs (including reviewer list, timestamps, and merge approval signal).
- CI run outputs for the build+release jobs for those PRs (logs and artifact checksums).
- Secret rotation records for short-lived credentials (rotation timestamps and KMS key IDs).
- Change management tickets and approver audit trail for each release.

If you can send a packaged bundle (or a Drive link) and call out any redactions/scoped exclusions, that will help. We aim to close this checklist with Greenline by May 30.

Can you confirm expected delivery date?

Best,
Alex (Veridian Assessment)

--
Alex Morgan
Lead Security Assessor, Veridian Audit
security-assessor@veridian.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Security Assessor <security-assessor@veridian.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 13:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SDLC provenance, CI and secrets rotation

Alex —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We can provide a scoped bundle covering the three representative releases you mentioned. Plan below:  

1) Artifacts we will provide by 2025-05-22 EOD (PST):
   - cr-audit-log-202504.zip: PR metadata export (approvals, reviewer emails, timestamps, merge commit SHAs).
   - ci-job-4521-output.txt: trimmed CI logs for build/test/release pipeline runs (we will redact ephemeral build tokens).
   - secret-rotation-summary-2025Q1.pdf: rotation schedule and KMS key IDs used for short-lived tokens.
   - JIRA-4821: change tickets correlating each release with approver comments (attachments inside ZIP).

2) Redactions and exclusions: we will redact raw secret values and any customer PII in CI logs; we will include checksums for released artifacts and signed provenance where available.

3) Point-of-contact for any follow-ups: Monica Patel (appsec) and Priyom Das (CI owner) — both CC'd.

If that timeline works, we will upload to a shared Drive link and send the link plus MD5s.

Regards,
Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Head of Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Assessor <security-assessor@veridian.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SDLC provenance, CI and secrets rotation

Thanks Rafael — quick status and notes from the CI/appsec side:  

- I exported the reviewer/approval timeline from our Gerrit/GitHub audit export for the three PRs (PR-#2341, PR-#2378, PR-#2410). That CSV includes approver handle, approval timestamp, and the COALESCED_APPROVAL token we use internally. I will include mapping to human names in the bundle.

- CI job 4521 is the canonical release pipeline run for PR-#2410 — logs include artifact signing step and checksum verification. See ci-job-4521-output.txt (trimmed to remove recurring third-party noise).

- Secret rotation: we rotated short-lived deploy tokens on 2025-03-11 and rotated the KMS key used to wrap them on 2025-04-02. The summary PDF lists key IDs (projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/rot-2025-04).

- Change management: JIRA-4821 contains the approval chain. Note: one approver used an emergency override for a rollback on 2025-02-28; we included the rollback ticket and rationale.

Attachments in the bundle will be: cr-audit-log-202504.zip, ci-job-4521-output.txt, secret-rotation-summary-2025Q1.pdf. I will upload and share the Drive link tomorrow morning.

Action items for Priyom: please confirm the CI log extraction is sanitized (no token leaks) and add MD5 checksums to the artifact manifest.

Monica

--
Monica Patel
Senior AppSec Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Assessor <security-assessor@veridian.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 15:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SDLC provenance & rotation logs — bundle uploaded

Monica / Rafael / Alex —

Bundle uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3ExampleLink  

What I uploaded (file stubs inside Drive folder):
- cr-audit-log-202504.zip (contains PR-2341.csv, PR-2378.csv, PR-2410.csv; reviewer->approver mapping included)
- ci-job-4521-output.txt (trimmed, redacted for tokens; includes artifact signing trace and checksums)
- secret-rotation-summary-2025Q1.pdf (rotation dates, KMS key IDs, rotation runbook link)
- JIRA-4821-export.json (exported comments + approver usernames)

MD5 checksums provided in artifact_manifest.md (attached to folder). No raw secrets included. If you need signed provenance (Sigstore attestation) for any release artifact, we have an additional step to extract and can provide it under NDA — let us know.

Alex — expected follow-ups you might ask for: sample Sigstore attestation, CI job environment snapshot, and the rollback playbook referenced in JIRA-4821. Happy to pull those if needed; ETA ~2 business days.

Thanks,
Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Platform Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Attachments: cr-audit-log-202504.zip (archive), ci-job-4521-output.txt (text), secret-rotation-summary-2025Q1.pdf (pdf)
